name: ai.acubic/acubic
title: Acubic
description: Explain, screen, build and backtest systematic portfolios from eToro and Trading 212 universes.

tools.name: acubic_search_knowledge
tools.description: Searches what Acubic publishes (blog, guides, methodology, FAQ, pricing) and returns passages with links to cite. Use it for how Acubic builds and backtests strategies, plan limits and the broker connections. It does not look up individual stocks (use acubic_lookup_instrument); for one term use acubic_explain.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

kinds.description: Limit to some kinds of content.

tools.name: acubic_list_strategy_templates
tools.description: Lists the ready preset strategies, one per experience level and risk level (largest accepted drawdown), plus Custom (advanced): the full engine. Each preset gives its universe rules, recommended pair and the arguments for acubic_create_strategy. Use it to explore or compare presets before choosing; single settings and their ids are in acubic_list_strategy_options.

risk_level.description: One risk level only (largest accepted drawdown).

tools.name: acubic_lookup_instrument
tools.description: Looks up a stock, ETF, crypto asset or currency pair by ticker, ISIN or name: its identity, whether it is in Acubic's tradable universe, whether eToro and Trading 212 list it, and any equivalent product Acubic substitutes (e.g. a UCITS ETF). Identity only: no price, return or rating. To filter many by metrics use acubic_screen_universe.

query.description: A ticker (AAPL, BTCUSD), an ISIN (US0378331005) or part of a name.

tools.name: acubic_screen_universe
tools.description: Applies filter rules (e.g. market cap at least $10 billion, P/E at most 25; AND, up to 20) to the universe eToro and Trading 212 both hold, after optional asset class, region, sector and include narrowing. Returns how many pass, per asset class, with up to 25 example rows, from the latest snapshot (as_of). A stock-only metric passes funds and crypto. To rank names for a strategy use acubic_rank_candidates.

asset_classes.description: Narrow to these asset classes first.

order_by.description: Order the example rows by this metric.

metric.description: A filter metric id (acubic_list_strategy_options, section filters).

value.description: The metric's unit: US dollars for market_cap, percent for pct metrics (40 = 40%).

tools.name: acubic_explain
tools.description: Explains one investing term or Acubic setting in plain language (a metric such as P/E or maximum drawdown, a filter, ranking or weighting method, risk level, rebalance or backtest term): its meaning, how Acubic uses it, default, caveats and its page. Use it whenever the user asks what a term means, so the answer matches how Acubic computes it. It does not say what a person should choose. For articles, pricing or the FAQ use acubic_search_knowledge.

topic.description: A term or option id, e.g. 'P/E ratio', 'pe', 'cap_rank_10', 'walk-forward'.

kind.description: Limit to one kind of term.

tools.name: acubic_list_strategy_options
tools.description: Lists every choice the strategy builder offers, with ids, trade-offs and defaults: universe, filter metrics, include lists, ranking methods, weighting methods, rebalance, backtest settings and recipes. Optionally one section. It describes options; the choice is the person's. For ready presets use acubic_list_strategy_templates.

experience.description: Keep only the options available at this experience level.

tools.name: acubic_get_account
tools.description: Returns the signed-in person's plan, allowance used and when it resets, live-portfolio limits, language, experience level, and a plan comparison with an upgrade link. It does not return the email, payment or broker details. For live holdings use acubic_get_portfolio.

tools.name: acubic_list_strategies
tools.description: Lists the signed-in person's saved strategies, newest first: name, kind (draft, paper or live), holdings count, method, backtest date and link; mode archived shows the archive. It has no performance figures: use acubic_get_strategy for one strategy, acubic_get_backtest for results.

mode.description: Kind of strategy. archived: deleted and still restorable.

tools.name: acubic_get_strategy
tools.description: Returns one saved strategy: holdings and weights, its settings (experience and risk level, ranking, weighting, asset count, filters, locks), data date, the summary of its latest saved backtest and its broker connection. It also accepts the build_id of a finished build (while it runs use acubic_get_build_status). Figures are hypothetical and carry a disclosure. For the full backtest use acubic_get_backtest.

build_id.description: A build_id of acubic_create_strategy; resolves to the strategy once saved.

tools.name: acubic_get_backtest
tools.description: Returns the latest saved walk-forward backtest of one strategy: assumptions, CAGR, volatility, Sharpe and Sortino, maximum drawdown and total return against the S&P 500 (SPY), yearly returns, drawdown episodes and last holdings; include adds the equity curve. Figures are hypothetical and carry a disclosure. Read it once a run has finished; to follow a run use acubic_get_backtest_status.

strategy_id.description: The strategy whose latest saved backtest to read.

run_id.description: A finished run of acubic_run_backtest to read.

include.description: equity_series: curves vs SPY (up to 200 points); performance_summary: report rows. detailed includes both.

tools.name: acubic_get_backtest_status
tools.description: Checks a run of acubic_run_backtest without opening a card: percent done and poll_after_seconds, then the headline figures (hypothetical, with a disclosure). A run that failed or was cancelled is an error and nothing was charged. Use it to wait; read the full result once with acubic_get_backtest.

strategy_id.description: The strategy the run belongs to.

tools.name: acubic_get_build_status
tools.description: Tracks a new draft from acubic_create_strategy by its build_id while it is assembled: progress and poll_after_seconds, then the saved strategy's id to open once. A failed or cancelled build is an error that cost nothing. Backtests have acubic_get_backtest_status.

tools.name: acubic_get_portfolio
tools.description: Returns holdings, value, return since activation and the last rebalance outcome of the person's live or paper-money strategies, from Acubic's latest daily snapshot (as_of); it does not contact the broker and never returns credentials or account numbers. Use it for how a running portfolio is doing; to start automating use acubic_go_live.

strategy_id.description: One strategy; omit for all that have a live or paper book.

tools.name: acubic_create_strategy
tools.description: Creates and saves a new draft strategy from the acubic.ai builder's choices: universe, include lists, asset count, sizes, ranking, weighting, filter rules, limits, and tickers to add, exclude or lock. A preset (template_id) fixes the menu; without one every engine argument is open. It uses one portfolio generation from the plan's allowance; with a candidates_id from acubic_rank_candidates it saves that pick at no generation cost. A saved strategy keeps its method: to try another, build again (see allocation); acubic_regenerate_suggestion does not change it. May return a build_id for acubic_get_build_status. To edit one use acubic_update_strategy. Always show the automation.url it returns (automate on acubic.ai).

template_id.description: An id from acubic_list_strategy_templates: a preset, or advanced for the engine.

experience.description: Legacy: beginner or intermediate with risk_level selects a preset; prefer template_id. Omit for an engine build.

risk_level.description: Preset only (legacy path): largest acceptable drawdown; prefer template_id.

position_sizing.description: Default: the sizes recommended for the number of assets.

ranking.description: A preset: card (its menu: acubic_list_strategy_templates). The engine: rank_method or rank_blend.

allocation.description: Weighting id (acubic_list_strategy_options, weighting); default: the recommended one. To compare: acubic_rank_candidates once, then this tool with its candidates_id and each allocation in turn.

filter_rules.description: Each rule: metric, op, value in the metric's unit (US dollars for market_cap, percent for pct metrics: 40 = 40%).

excluded_symbols.description: Names removed from the screened pool (Step 1).

locked_symbols.description: Always held, exempt from every filter.

custom_symbols.description: Tickers to add to the pool, checked as on acubic.ai.

correlation_limit.description: Not offered yet: omit it unless acubic_list_strategy_options shows it offered; then 0.50-0.95, step 0.05 (preset: 0.80).

selection_limits.description: Min/max share of the selection per sector, country or asset class.

candidates_id.description: A ranked list from acubic_rank_candidates (valid 1 hour).

selected_symbols.description: Hand-picked names of the candidates_id list (not with allocation or correlation limits).

select_count.description: Top N to select (10, 15, 20, 30 or 50 within the count range; see selection.select_counts). Not with selected_symbols.

index_card.description: Build the level's index card (template level_mix.index_card) instead of ranked stocks; no ranking or allocation.

recipe_id.description: A recipe id (acubic_list_strategy_options, recipes): sets ranking, sectors, allocation and asset count unless given; your filter_rules add to its own.

metric.description: A filter metric id (acubic_list_strategy_options, section filters).

value.description: The metric's unit: US dollars for market_cap, percent for pct metrics (40 = 40%).

McpCountRange.description: Number of assets, min and max.

McpGroupBound.description: Share of the selection by count, percent.

McpRanking.description: A preset: card. The engine: rank_method or rank_blend.

card.description: A preset's ranking card, from its menu in acubic_list_strategy_templates (by template_id, or experience and risk_level).

McpSelectionLimits.description: Group names as acubic_rank_candidates rows show them.

default_max_pct.description: Default max percent for every sector or country without its own cap.

max_weight_pct.description: 1 to 100, step 1; at most 60 unless the lowest asset count is 1 (then 100).

tools.name: acubic_update_strategy
tools.description: Updates the name, description, filter rules, include lists or Exclude list of one saved strategy, and lists each previous value. Holdings are not recomputed. It cannot change the ranking, weighting, limits or sizes: for that build a new strategy with acubic_create_strategy. A strategy with a broker connection accepts name and description only.

excluded_symbols.description: The whole Exclude list (replaces the saved one; [] clears it; up to 200 tickers, none locked). Never bought; a held one is sold at the next rebalance.

metric.description: A filter metric id (acubic_list_strategy_options, section filters).

value.description: The metric's unit: US dollars for market_cap, percent for pct metrics (40 = 40%).

tools.name: acubic_run_backtest
tools.description: Runs a walk-forward backtest of one saved strategy and saves it in place of the previous one: at each rebalance the strategy is rebuilt from the data then available, with transaction costs, against the S&P 500 (SPY). 1 to 10 years, monthly, quarterly or annual rebalancing, 0 to 200 bps costs. It uses one backtest from the plan's monthly allowance, returned if the run fails or is cancelled. May return a run_id for acubic_get_backtest_status. One MCP run per person at a time. Results are hypothetical and carry a disclosure. To read a saved backtest use acubic_get_backtest.

years.description: Length of the test in years.

rebalance_freq.description: M monthly, Q quarterly, A annual (needs at least 3 years).

transaction_cost_bps.description: Cost of each buy and sell in basis points.

tools.name: acubic_delete_strategy
tools.description: Deletes a draft or paper-money strategy by archiving it together with its saved backtest; it can be restored within 30 days (acubic_restore_strategy). A strategy with a broker connection is removed on acubic.ai. The person is asked to confirm, or the result gives a confirm_token to pass back once they agree. To stop a running backtest use acubic_cancel_backtest.

strategy_id.description: The draft or paper-money strategy to delete.

confirm_token.description: For clients without elicitation: the confirm_token from the first call's confirmation_required result, sent once the person agreed.

tools.name: acubic_rank_candidates
tools.description: Ranks the candidates of a design before anything is saved (Order & Select on acubic.ai): the ranked list, page by page, with score, per-factor values (vs industry: also the peers' median), sector, country and asset class, and the pick the site would make. A fresh ranking uses one portfolio generation. The list is kept 1 hour under candidates_id: paging, previewing a pick or re-ranking it cost nothing more, and acubic_create_strategy saves the pick, once per weighting you want to compare. It saves nothing. To count names that pass filters use acubic_screen_universe.

candidates_id.description: A ranked list from acubic_rank_candidates (valid 1 hour).

template_id.description: An id from acubic_list_strategy_templates: a preset, or advanced for the engine.

experience.description: Legacy: beginner or intermediate with risk_level selects a preset; prefer template_id. Omit for an engine build.

risk_level.description: Preset only (legacy path): largest acceptable drawdown; prefer template_id.

position_sizing.description: Default: the sizes recommended for the number of assets.

ranking.description: A preset: card (acubic_list_strategy_templates). The engine: rank_method or rank_blend. With candidates_id: re-rank that pool.

filter_rules.description: Each rule: metric, op, value in the metric's own unit.

excluded_symbols.description: Names removed from the screened pool (Step 1).

locked_symbols.description: Always selected, exempt from every filter.

custom_symbols.description: Tickers to add to the pool, checked as on acubic.ai.

correlation_limit.description: Not offered yet: omit it unless acubic_list_strategy_options shows it offered; then 0.50-0.95, step 0.05 (preset: 0.80).

selection_limits.description: Min/max share of the selection per sector, country or asset class.

selected_symbols.description: Preview a hand-picked selection of candidates_id (not with allocation or correlation limits).

select_count.description: Top N to select (10, 15, 20, 30 or 50 within the count range; see selection.select_counts). Not with selected_symbols.

recipe_id.description: A recipe id (acubic_list_strategy_options, recipes): sets ranking, sectors, allocation and asset count unless given; your filter_rules add to its own.

metric.description: A filter metric id (acubic_list_strategy_options, section filters).

value.description: The metric's unit: US dollars for market_cap, percent for pct metrics (40 = 40%).

McpCountRange.description: Number of assets, min and max.

McpGroupBound.description: Share of the selection by count, percent.

McpRanking.description: A preset: card. The engine: rank_method or rank_blend.

card.description: A preset's ranking card, from its menu in acubic_list_strategy_templates (by template_id, or experience and risk_level).

McpSelectionLimits.description: Group names as acubic_rank_candidates rows show them.

default_max_pct.description: Default max percent for every sector or country without its own cap.

max_weight_pct.description: 1 to 100, step 1; at most 60 unless the lowest asset count is 1 (then 100).

tools.name: acubic_regenerate_suggestion
tools.description: Regenerates the suggested portfolio of one saved strategy with its saved settings, like Regenerate on acubic.ai, and returns the holdings and weights; the saved strategy is not changed. It never changes the ranking or the weighting: for another one, build with acubic_create_strategy. It counts against the same ranking and weighting attempt limit as the website.

strategy_id.description: The saved strategy whose suggested portfolio is regenerated.

suggestion_id.description: Read a suggestion still being computed (from a running result).

tools.name: acubic_go_live
tools.description: Returns a signed link, valid 15 minutes, to automate one strategy on acubic.ai with the person's own eToro or Trading 212 account, where they connect the broker and activate it. It also says whether the plan includes live portfolios. Use it whenever the person wants to automate or go live; for a running portfolio use acubic_get_portfolio.

strategy_id.description: The strategy to continue on acubic.ai.

tools.name: acubic_project_strategy
tools.description: Runs a Monte Carlo of 500 paths over 1, 3, 5 or 10 years for one saved strategy, from its walk-forward backtest (the AI Scenario Simulation of acubic.ai): bear case (5th percentile), median, bull case (95th) and the percentile fan. Hypothetical, with a disclosure. Paid plans only. For past results use acubic_get_backtest.

tools.name: acubic_get_strategy_history
tools.description: Returns the Historical tab of one saved strategy: its saved weights bought and held over 1 month to 5 years, with return, CAGR, volatility, Sharpe and maximum drawdown beside the S&P 500 or a custom benchmark, and the daily series. Hypothetical, with a disclosure. For the walk-forward test use acubic_get_backtest.

weight.description: Relative weight, normalised to sum to 1.

tools.name: acubic_cancel_backtest
tools.description: Cancels a backtest that is still running, like Cancel on acubic.ai: the allowance it used is returned and the previous saved result stays. Needs the run_id from acubic_run_backtest. To remove a strategy use acubic_delete_strategy.

strategy_id.description: The strategy the run belongs to.

tools.name: acubic_restore_strategy
tools.description: Restores a strategy deleted with acubic_delete_strategy, with its holdings, settings and backtest, within 30 days. acubic_list_strategies with mode archived lists the ones that can be restored.
